create_chat_completion_sampler: create a ChatCompletionSampler instance to sample from OpenAI chat completion API with model and temperature settings
create_completion_sampler: create a CompletionSampler instance to sample from OpenAI completion API with model and max tokens settings
run_eval: run an Eval subclass instance with a SamplerBase to produce an EvalResult containing score, metrics, htmls, and convos
aggregate_eval_results: aggregate a list of SingleEvalResult objects into a single EvalResult with computed mean and std metrics
generate_html_report: generate a standalone HTML report string from an EvalResult containing metrics table and example conversations
